designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Secretary of the Interior to accept Indiana's donation of the George Rogers Clark Memorial in Vincennes and establish it as George Rogers Clark National Historical Park.
designationHistory.note: The memorial building was dedicated by the State of Indiana on June 14, 1936 (NPS History Collection); that state action is not a federal designation.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Indiana), 'Authorized July 23, 1966'
